Story: So What If We're Different?
In a little garden lived three best friends: White Bunny, Grey Bear and Chubby Tiger.
One day, the three of them had a race.
One, two, three, go!
White Bunny ran as fast as the wind.
Grey Bear ran a little slower.
And Chubby Tiger, with his round tummy and short legs, waddled along behind.
At the finish line, Chubby Tiger said sadly:
Why are my legs so short? I can't run fast like you!
White Bunny comforted him:
That's okay! Each of us is special!
Grey Bear scratched his head:
But I don't know what's special about me!
Just then, a strong wind blew by.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Bunny's yellow scarf flew up onto a high branch.
"Oh no! My scarf!" cried Bunny.
Bunny jumped and jumped, but couldn't reach it.
Chubby Tiger tried too, but he couldn't reach it either.
Grey Bear stood up, stretched his long arms, and gently took the scarf down.
"Hooray for Grey Bear!" cheered the friends.
Bear said happily:
So I'm good at something too!
The three friends went on playing.
Suddenly, splash!
Bear's ball fell into the pond.
Bunny was worried:
Oh no, how do we get the ball back? I can't swim!
Bear shook his head:
Me neither!
Chubby Tiger shouted:
Let me do it!
Chubby Tiger jumped into the water, swam fast and brought the ball back.
Bunny's eyes went wide:
Wow! You're a great swimmer!
Chubby Tiger was overjoyed:
So I run slowly, but I swim really well!
Grey Bear smiled:
Bunny runs fast, I'm tall and strong, and Tiger swims well!
Bunny nodded:
That's right! We're not the same, but everyone has something wonderful!
Chubby Tiger said happily:
From now on, I won't be sad about my short legs!
The three friends held hands and sang as they walked:
You are you, and I am me.
A little different, so what!
No teasing, always caring.
Let's play together, friends forever!
Today's lesson: So what if we're different!
